prompt:
Use the measured design system of Preference Model (preferencemodel.com), from the Artspo book "The Artbook library" (https://artbook.dev/library/), as a reference. These are measurements of the live site, not its code: rebuild the feel with your own content.

## Palette
- Surfaces, by share of the page: #FFFFFF 48%, #E8E8E8 27%, #FAB3F6 12%, #000000 11%
- Text, by amount of text: #000000 80%, #FFFFFF 20%

## Type
- Display: MartianMono 20px/500, letter-spacing 0em, line-height 1.5, uppercase
- Body: TWKLausanne 20px, line-height 28px
- Scale (px/weight): 36/300, 24/300, 20/500, 18/350
- Families by text share: TWKLausanne 88%, MartianMono 11%, FKRasterGroteskSharp 1%

## Shape
- Borders: 1px solid oklab(0.999994 0.0000455678 0.0000200868 / 0.3) (8×); 1px solid #000000 (5×); 1px solid #FFFFFF (1×)
- Spacing: 4px grid; section padding 50px, 32px, 16px, 40px; gaps 24px, 16px, 12px, 8px

## Buttons
- outline, text #000000, radius 0px, padding 16px 16px, 36px/400, border 2px #000000

## Motion
- Libraries: none detected (plain CSS/JS)
- Declared transition on border-color, color, background-color, outline-color, text-decoration-color: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) (68 elements)

## Not captured (don't invent these)
- Click-triggered interactions (menus, modals, tabs, accordions) — capture never clicks
- Hover states were not forced — see Declared transitions for their timing; the visual end state is unknown

## Patterns in this book built on it
Research index, Retro machine pop, Color-indexed sections, Numbered sections, Ruled structure, Static by design, Hard edges, flat depth, Machine-voice labels, One family, scale does the work

Rules: Rebuild from these measurements, never from a real site's code, text, logos or imagery. A font in <angle brackets> is a placeholder: pick a licensed face of that kind. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
